Changelog

Source: NEWS.md

randolist 1.0.0

First package version. createRandoList() and composite_strata() are revisions of the legacy createRandoListNew.R (last changed June 2024), which is kept unchanged in inst/legacy/ and used as the reference in the tests.

Same results as the legacy code

  • Same seed and arguments give the same list (random numbers are drawn in the same order). Verified by tests over many seeds and settings.

Bug fixes (both only affect n.block_permute > 0)

  • A permutation group holding a single patient (possible in the last, truncated block) got a random number from 1:id instead of its own ID, which could duplicate patient numbers. Fixed; other rows and the following strata are unchanged.
  • When all permutation groups had the same number of patients (e.g. fixed block length 4, nPat = 16, n.block_permute = 2), sapply() returned a matrix that unlist() left as a matrix, and the legacy function stopped with “pat_id not found”. Fixed.

Changes

  • The caller’s sample.kind is restored on exit, also after an error (legacy reset it to "default").
  • New seed, sample_kind and seed_per_stratum arguments; the function stops if no seed has been set.
  • Input validation with clear messages; strata with nPat <= arms or 0 are allowed (legacy stopped).
  • Randomisation numbers that are not unique are refused.
  • Generation metadata in attr(x, "rando_info").

Documentation

  • New article “Where the legacy code goes wrong, and how randolist fixes it”, which runs the legacy and new code side by side for every case.
  • The new function also refuses arm names that do not match arms (legacy silently produced NA arms).

New helpers for the SOP

  • dummy_arm_names(), check_final_setup() and generate_seed() for the dummy/final switch.
  • check_rando_list() to verify balance within blocks and unique IDs.
  • write_rando_list() writes SOP-compliant file names and a log with MD5 sums.
  • A study script template in inst/templates/.
